exposure: Timing of previous cesarean section (first stage, second stage, elective)
C-section during the first stage of labor
cohort: 2879 women following term vaginal delivery; 1,455 who had their first VBAC and 1,424 who had vaginal delivery without prior C-section
finding: VBAC is associated with higher rates of postpartum complications, primarily PPH, with the risk being significantly increased in VBAC following a second stage cesarean section.
mod_finding: VBAC is associated with higher rates of postpartum complications, primarily PPH, with the risk being significantly increased in VBAC following a second stage cesarean section.
